diagnostic: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #105153 does not request a warranted, reproducible code change; it is a QA-execution false positive for behavior the repository's own maintainer analysis documents as expected/by-design. Evidence: (1) MelvinBot 'Issue Analysis' on the issue states 'This works as designed. It is not a bug ... You don't need a code change ... close this issue' and independently reproduced that the 'Refresh needed' state DOES appear once a request actually runs (tab switch / re-submit) and stays without looping. (2) An independent contributor proposal (c2026/105153 comment) reaches the same conclusion: 'Expected Behavior ... No code changes should be made to the client application.' (3) Root cause is confirmed in source: the debug toggle only merges a flag into Onyx (src/libs/actions/Network.ts:16-18 via src/components/TestToolMenu.tsx:237-238); src/libs/NetworkState.ts:219-230 reacts only when the flag turns OFF (recovery), and src/libs/HttpUtils.ts:146-151 fails only *future* requests. The 'Refresh needed' view is gated strictly on searchResults.errors (src/components/Search/index.tsx:343; render at 1394-1452), which is written only by a failed search request (src/libs/actions/Search.ts failureData + NO_RESPONSE catch at Search.ts:1505-1525). Toggling the flag fires no request, so no error is expected while cached offline-first results remain. (4) The repro's step 9 drops the request-triggering action that PR #103877 itself keeps in its own step 9 ('Turn "Simulate failing network requests" back on, tap Refresh on the visible tab, and verify the refresh-needed view comes back once and stays'), so the reported 'Actual Result' is the correct product outcome. (5) Executed on the unchanged base: tests/ui/SearchPageTest.tsx is 47/47 passing, including PR #103877's regression test 'requests a query again when its tab is shown after an earlier visit left it failed', proving the error state reappears whenever a request is actually triggered. (6) Competition/withdrawn-funding checks: 0 open/closed PRs reference #105153 (GitHub search total_count=0); issue is open with live $175 funding (Upwork job 2115113687798456110, Last Price Increase 2026-10-27); no competition or withdrawal found. Because there is no reproducible product defect and the only change that would satisfy the issue's literal expectation (auto-firing a request / wiping cached results when a debug-only flag flips) is explicitly rejected by the maintainer analysis and an independent contributor as an architectural regression, proceeding would mean manufacturing a fix for rejected/expected behavior, which this task forbids. Checkout was left unmodified (git status clean; only node_modules installed under the checkout, no source edits).

Because there is no genuine defect and no legitimate code change, proceeding would mean manufacturing a fix for rejected/expected behavior, which this task forbids. Checkout left unmodified.
